layouts.name: CAtlasedImage_GetParent
layouts.notes: CAtlasedRectsVisual::InsertAtlasImageAtIndex writes the owning CAtlasedRectsVisual pointer to CAtlasedImage +80 and RemoveAtlasImage clears it; CButton::RedrawVisual reads the same link while moving atlas images. Verified on uDWM 22000.194, 22621.6630, and 26100.7705. On 26100.7705, DisconnectFromParent reads +80, InsertAtlasImageAtIndex writes +80, and CButton::RedrawVisual routes movement through DisconnectFromParent and AddAtlasImage. ButtonGlowHandler follows the owner to restore the hot glow's atlas-array z-order. The open range remains runtime behavior rather than proof for unanalyzed future builds.

layouts.name: CAtlasedImage_GetSize
layouts.notes: Verified on x64 uDWM 17763.719, 18362.267, 19041.3758, 20348.2582, 22000.194, 22621.6630, 26100.7705 and 26100.8972: CTopLevelWindow::GetActualWindowRect uses +24 as cx for the side atlas images and +28 as cy for the bottom image; CAtlasedImage::SetSize independently compares both 32-bit dimensions and writes the full 8-byte SIZE at +24. The 22000.194 background workaround uses an all-zero SIZE sentinel. The open range is runtime behavior, not evidence for unanalyzed builds.
